title: Closing thanks
summary: Final thanks between Mance and the interviewers.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well we’ve had a lot of fun here today. And I’d like to say that this has all been live, mistakes and all. But it’s been a great pleasure sharing your recollections and your views on jazz.
This has been my pleasure. I’ve really enjoyed it, really. I wish all interviews were like this. © Fillius Jazz Archive -22-
So on behalf of Hamilton College and Mike Woods, I’m Monk Rowe and I want to thank Junior Mance for sharing this time with us. It’s been really great.
And I want to thank you for having me.
